journey.title: Tell what can never work from what is merely blocked
journey.purpose: The journey that decides whether this scenario is honest. Unlike every other ramp, this one has rows that will never pass — and rows that look identical but are one command away from passing. An operator must be able to tell them apart at a glance, reach the specific cause of each blocked state, and never be offered a remedy for something structurally impossible.

steps.intent: See terminal and actionable rows side by side and distinguish them without relying on colour.
Read a complete explanation of a permanent limitation, with no action control present.
Read a blocked-but-fixable state whose cause is a missing GUI session, and see its specific next action.
Confirm a second fixable cause on the same node yields a different message and a different next action.
See one device offering two strategies with different tiers, and understand which produces release-grade evidence before choosing.
Recognise the third category — a host that works today for validation but cannot produce a submittable build.

claims.statement: No unsupported state anywhere in this journey presents an action control or a suggested fix.
claims.rationale: S2I-P0-003. An affordance implies a path. Offering one for a category error sends the operator to spend time on something impossible, and quietly destroys trust in every other disposition the UI reports.

claims.statement: Every unavailable disposition reachable in this journey names both the missing capability and a next action.
claims.rationale: The counterpart promise: if terminal states must offer nothing, actionable states must always offer something specific.

claims.statement: Missing GUI session and missing simulator runtime variant produce different messages and different next actions on the same node.
claims.rationale: S2I-P0-003. A single generic 'macOS node not ready' would make both undiagnosable, which is the failure mode this journey exists to catch.

claims.statement: Terminal, blocked-but-fixable, and validate-only are three distinguishable states, separable without colour discrimination.
claims.rationale: Most ramps have two categories. This one has three, and the third is dated — an operator who cannot see it will discover it when an upload is rejected.

claims.statement: The journey completes without leaving the operator surface.
claims.rationale: The CLI is the complete control surface for agents; the UI must be complete for diagnosis, or the matrix is only a status light.
